verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents a full Admin/Management API that mirrors all dashboard actions (docs-16, docs-30, docs-40), plus an official CLI (docs-18) and an official MCP server explicitly built for AI assistants/agents to programmatically access the Admin API (docs-17, docs-29, docs-47). This directly satisfies driving the product via documented public API/agentic tooling. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s) and independent third-party corroboration of API completeness.
